label.web: From the web · cited, not verified
label.hint_free: Answered from the model's own knowledge; nothing was compared with sources.
label.hint_grounded: Every statement was compared with the excerpts of your sources.
label.hint_mixed: Statements taken from your sources are checked and marked; the rest is general knowledge.
label.hint_web: The answer cites pages a web search found; their content was not verified.
label.hint_companion: The companion on this computer answered from its documents and notes, and its gate checked every number against the source a sentence cites before it was shown.
label.hint_companion_free: The companion on this computer answered from general knowledge; its gate removed links, but nothing was compared with sources.
label.hint_companion_template: No model wrote this: the companion answered with a fixed text, and its note says why.

mixed.cited_not_found: Cited, but not found in the source
mixed.note: Statements without a source are general knowledge of the model and were not checked.
